sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 40 Cost.
Cost recovery boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Reduces physical and magic damage taken by 50% for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Nullifies Cost reduction for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 90 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Applies Seraphic Element for 120 seconds to allied field. (Increases all stats by 40%, all elemental attacks by 4, and 40% HP boost to all allies.)
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 11000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 11000
